page.content:
Stand-up espresso counter that set the template for café machines worldwide.

How Italian coffee bar connects

  • Item: Espresso — Espresso is the defining drink of the Italian coffee bar.
  • Character: Howard Schultz — Schultz has said Milan's bars inspired the Starbucks espresso format.

What is Italian coffee bar?

The Italian bar — marble, quick espresso, cappuccino before 11 — is the social form espresso machines were built for, later copied and stretched by chains.

Key threads lead to Espresso and Howard Schultz.
